column1: # FRESH-DRAW confirmatory corpus — JVM arm. Committed before the run (see FRESHDRAW.md).
# The SAME frozen classifier (candor-java 0.23.1, sha256 bf572eb3…) as the replication run, on a NEW held-out
# corpus whose outcome is genuinely unknown at freeze time — no repo here appears in the replication manifest
# (../corpus-confirmatory/manifest.tsv) NOR in the developmental EXCLUDED set (../corpus-confirmatory/EXCLUDED.md).
# Driven by the JUnit ConsoleLauncher in ONE JVM (run_corpus.sh), NOT `mvn test` (Surefire forks don't inherit
# the -javaagent). role ∈ {H-test: perform effects in their OWN functions (drive checked>0) | fab-control:
# pure/dynamic transformers that should NOT fabricate an effect (checked≈0 — the fabrication mirror)}.
# HELD-OUT twice over: excludes the 12 replication repos AND the 8 developmental repos.

column7: H-test: CSVParser/CSVPrinter open real files by path in tests — Fs in its own functions
